history.summary: Freehold 2BR near Bartley MRT (CCL) at $1764 PSF — a respectable freehold tenure and a tight, liquid quantum ($1.33M), but the PSF is full for a 2015 boutique-ish project in this pocket and there is no URA data to anchor the trend. Weak arena record (146-273) and below-frontier placement signal the algorithm sees it as mediocre value.
history.rating_rationale: $1.328M / $1764 PSF puts a 753 sqft freehold 2BR in the deep, liquid sub-$1.5M band with broad buyer appeal, and Bartley MRT (Circle Line, one stop to Serangoon NEX) is a real plus. But $1764 PSF is on the higher side for a 2015 D19 development, the project is small, and the loss-heavy arena record (Elo 1016, 146-273-5, not on frontier) reflects that the price leaves little margin. Freehold protects long-term value but the entry is fully priced.
